projectDescription: An MCP (Model Context Protocol) server that exposes your documentation to AI assistants, enabling AI tools to search, retrieve, and reason over your docs in real time.
keyFeatures: Expose documentation to AI assistants via the Model Context Protocol
Built-in tools: search, list_pages, and get_page
Support for llms.txt and llms-full.txt sources
Compatible with Claude Desktop, Cursor, VS Code Copilot, and any MCP client
STDIO and Streamable HTTP transport modes
Authentication support for protected documentation sources
Easy configuration via a single config file
Works with Fumadocs, Mintlify, and any Markdown-based docs site
publicApiSurface: search — full-text search across documentation sources
get_page — fetch the full content of a specific page
STDIO transport — run as a local MCP server process
HTTP transport — run as a remote MCP server endpoint
llms.txt integration — auto-discover pages from llms.txt sitemap
config.json — configure doc sources, tools, and authentication
